findings.title: Operation descriptions end with the returned field names
findings.body: Seven of the eight selected root fields' doc comments end with the names their response exposes; gitea_version returns String and carries none. get:/repos/search returns an envelope and carries both lines; seven lines hit the 14-name cap. Both paginated operations carry the one-page/stop-condition sentence (references/schema-authoring.md § Paginated list operation descriptions) ahead of the Returns line.

findings.title: Object-typed entries in the Returns line render one level deep
findings.body: An object-typed entry in a Returns line renders one level deep: 11 brace groups, every one a Gitea_User, whose 22 fields hit the nested cap of 6, so every group ends (+16 more).
